quarterly_data.quarter: Musashi Seimitsu results presentation: FY2026 First Quarter (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Energy Solution business (results deck): the company calls its Hybrid SuperCapacitor (HSC) 'key infrastructure for power quality in AI data centers' - AI data centers are shifting to higher power levels and higher-efficiency power supply systems, growing AI clusters (training and inference) cause steep power fluctuations that must be absorbed, and demand for power quality and grid stability raises the importance of energy-storage devices. It cites METI's Battery Industry Strategy, which shifts focus beyond energy density to 'power density' (AI data centers among the uses), calling HSC a solution 'backed by national policy'. Capacity: the Yamanashi Hokuto Plant capacity expansion is underway and the Yamanashi Minami-Alps Plant was handed over in June 2026 and is ramping up to full-scale operation - 'strengthening production capability to meet robust demand'.
quarterly_data.figure: Minami-Alps Plant handed over June 2026; Hokuto Plant capacity expansion underway
